scope: Inert typed identities, strict carrier arithmetic/untrusted text codec, capability metadata, and current host authentication/service-policy lease interfaces. No runtime, radio, socket, TLS wrapper or permission store is implemented.

identity.lifetime: Constructors validate shape only. Authenticated fresh nonce creation, flow allocation without reuse, nonce retirement, broker epochs and continuity are mandatory adapter responsibilities, not established by these records.

carrier.text_encoding: strict ASCII prefix + canonical padded Base64; decode returns UntrustedCarrierPayload
carrier.application_capacity: ((mtu_bytes-4)//4)*3-header_bytes-authentication_bytes; all integer inputs explicit and capacity>=1
carrier.compatibility: No legacy fallback. Actual runtime dispatch must precede the existing public gateway early-return branch; this candidate does not add that handler.
carrier.profile: All values validated exact/finite; basis is a caller assertion, not measurement provenance. Observation age and non-backward supplied clocks checked on negotiation; physical path provenance remains MT02/MT12.

metadata.encoding: exact ASCII canonical JSON, sorted keys and service/feature lists; duplicate/missing/extra keys and nonfinite/bool integer values rejected
metadata.live_vs_finite: A finite one-send candidate that lacks incremental_stream/half_close must refuse Internet/SAGE negotiation. Capability claims require trusted local adapter provenance and authenticated remote transcript; these records do not implement those features.

rules: Exact nonboolean integer counts; no infinity, modulo, masking or silent widened wire field.
payload<=window,unconsumed andqueuedbytes; initialcredit<=window andunconsumed; window<=unconsumed and reassemblyframes*payload; peerflows<=globalflows.
Intersection uses minima, then carrier payload capacity, then reduces window/frame coverage and initial credit.
max_control_bytes bounds one logical control record, not one physical frame; bootstrap fragmentation/control wire layout pending.
Actual flow must enforce both frame-count and byte limits and charge retained reorder/unconsumed/duplicate bytes; static records do not implement memory accounting.

admission.untrusted_parse: parse_offer supplies zero identity or service authority.
admission.authenticate: Mandatory trusted host callback authenticate(exact_raw_offer,RouteBinding)->VerifiedOffer. Result must bind exact independently pinned full peer, SessionKey, route, raw SHA256 and fresh expiry. Host verifies channel_binding_digest provenance; this module implements no proof/MAC/handshake.
admission.authorize: Mandatory fresh per-service host read lease authorize(AdmissionRequest)->AbstractContextManager yielding AuthorityGrant for the exact nonce-bound request. Missing/truthy/cached/request-mismatched results refuse.
request_binding: actual local capabilities+carrier profile policy snapshot digest
admission.policy: Messaging consent, reachability advertisements, valid signatures, CRC, compact IDs, successful parsing and remote class labels do not authorize backhaul. Host authorizer must check current stored service policy under its lease; local_policy_digest is a snapshot hash and not an authority proof.
admission.clocks: Check original deadlines/profile at entry, grant-tightened deadlines/profile/proof expiry under the policy lease, and again after lease exit. Callback time and backwards clocks cannot return an already-expired snapshot.
admission.result: NegotiatedContract is inert historical admission snapshot. Every future dispatch must reacquire current service and broker authority; returned dataclass never restores live session or authorizes transmission.

routing.change: A locally admitted carrier/profile/route-generation change invalidates outstanding reservations and old compact lookups, resets retry timing from the new measured profile, and retains or tightens original application/authority deadlines. No route mutator, retry engine or reservation ledger is implemented in this increment.
routing.priority: Local policy maps Internet,SAGE andprotected messages tointeractive, knowledge tobulk. Remote priority/control labels are not metadata fields. Trusted receipt/control rate limits belong toMT04.
routing.outcome_scope: Enums only; actual exactly-once reservation/charge/reconciliation remains MT04/MT05.

sage.reason: PeerRouteDialResult.Authenticated=true bypasses normal pinned TLS; raw Meshticulum streams must keep false.
sage.retained: Pinned TLS1.3 and existing signed federation authorization/admission remain mandatory.
sage.feasibility: Overlay RTO cannot extend current SAGE local authorization lease/context. Slow-LoRa request feasibility is unmeasured; production integration needs explicit bounded request behavior or an approved node contract.

remaining: Authenticated OPEN/bootstrap/transcript/downgrade/replay protection and final DATA/ACK wire layout.
Negotiated compact reference lifecycle and authenticated frame/control verification.
Broker service demux/admission and exclusive owner integration.
MT04 measured fair scheduler, forward/firmwareACK/reverse budgets and actual reserve/commit.
Repaired MT05 live incremental stream/half-close, credit persistence and bounded failure.
MT06 verified-object trust/resume and existing pack/root contracts.
Actual HTTPS + authenticated SAGE exchange + verified chunk overLoRa together; no source/simulation acceptance implies those gates.
